name: auriga-workflow
description: The auriga workflow plugin: workflow skills — systematic-debugging (evidence-first diagnosis), test-driven-development (minimal behavior-first TDD), incremental-impl (implementation slicing), spec-design (requirement clarification), arch-design (architecture design), code-simplify (code simplification), session-compound (session compounding), goalify (autonomous /goal planning), deep-review (multi-dimensional PR review orchestrator), reviewer-creator (custom reviewer scaffolding), git-workflow (git lifecycle skill), documentation-and-adrs (architecture decision records and documentation discipline), docent (single-subagent code-comprehension HTML reports) — plus the git lifecycle hooks that enforce them: commit-reminder, pr-create-guard, pr-ready-guard, pr-merge-guard. Dual-Agent compatible (Claude Code + Codex).

interface.shortDescription: auriga workflow skills + git lifecycle guards
interface.longDescription: The complete auriga workflow in one plugin. Skills: systematic-debugging for evidence-first diagnosis, test-driven-development for minimal behavior-first TDD without a separate test agent, incremental-impl for implementation slicing, spec-design for requirement clarification, arch-design for architecture design, code-simplify for code simplification, session-compound for session compounding, goalify for planning and dispatching an autonomous /goal, deep-review as a multi-dimensional PR review orchestrator, reviewer-creator for scaffolding project-level custom reviewers, git-workflow describing the git lifecycle, documentation-and-adrs for architecture decision records and documentation discipline, and docent for explicit-invocation code-comprehension reports — a single dedicated subagent reads the relevant code and emits a self-contained interactive HTML walkthrough. Hooks that enforce the workflow: commit-reminder nudges the agent to commit at semantic boundaries, pr-create-guard injects a PR-body snapshot and flags non-Conventional-Commits titles after `gh pr create`, pr-ready-guard hard-blocks structural problems (stray planning docs, unfinalized active specs, unpushed commits) at PR Ready transitions — firing on both `gh pr ready` and non-draft `gh pr create` — and pr-merge-guard blocks merge while Acceptance criteria or Test plan items remain unchecked.
defaultPrompt: Use the auriga workflow skills when the workflow calls for them.
